key: Home of the Move Relearner
en: Home of the Move Relearner
ja: わざ思い出しの家

key: Onyx Arcade- Test your skills!
en: Onyx Arcade- Test your skills!
ja: オニキスゲームセンター――腕試し!

key: Ugh, I can't beat the high score!
en: Ugh, I can't beat the high score!
ja: うわー、ハイスコア更新できない!

key: I can't beat anything.
en: I can't beat anything.
ja: オレ、何にも勝てないよ。

key: This sucks.
en: This sucks.
ja: 最悪だ。

key: It sucks that the arcade games are all broken. I wanna playyy!
en: It sucks that the arcade games are all broken. I wanna playyy!
ja: ゲームが全部壊れてるとかサイテー。遊びたいのにー!

key: Don't you think you should take a break anyway? We have a test soon.
en: Don't you think you should take a break anyway? We have a test soon.
ja: そもそも休憩した方がいいんじゃない? もうすぐテストなんだから。

key: Well, the arcade's back online.
en: Well, the arcade's back online.
ja: あ、ゲームセンター、また使えるようになったんだ。

key: So my friend's basically never going to speak to me again unless it's down for patching.
en: So my friend's basically never going to speak to me again unless it's down for patching.
ja: だから友達、パッチ当てで止まってる時以外、もう口きいてくれないと思う。

key: Woo-hoo.
en: Woo-hoo.
ja: わーい。

key: Do you go to this school? Or are you here to challenge the Gym?
en: Do you go to this school? Or are you here to challenge the Gym?
ja: この学校の生徒? それともジムに挑戦しに来たの?

key: You're cut out for either.
en: You're cut out for either.
ja: どっちにしたって、あなたにはお似合いね。

key: Good luck!
en: Good luck!
ja: 頑張って!

key: Obviously Julia is the best! She's so hyper and fun! Kaaaaaaaa--
en: Obviously Julia is the best! She's so hyper and fun!  Kaaaaaaaa--
ja: 絶対ジュリアが一番だよ! すっごいハイテンションで楽しいし! かーーー――

key: Excuse me? Can't you see you don't belong here?
en: Excuse me? Can't you see you don't belong here?
ja: はぁ? あんた場違いだって気づいてないの?

key: Eh, whatever, it's a silly.
en: Eh, whatever, it's a silly.
ja: はぁ、まあいいや、しょうもないし。

key: Once, there were four girls- all roommates- who graduated from here to be Gym Leaders. Every one of them! Wouldn't it be neat to do something like that with just your friends?
en: Once, there were four girls- all roommates- who graduated from here to be Gym Leaders. Every one of them! Wouldn't it be neat to do something like that with just your friends?
ja: 昔、ここのルームメイトだった四人の女の子が、そろってジムリーダーになったんだって! みんな! 友達同士でそんなことできたら素敵じゃない?

key: No way. Titania is wicked cool. She doesn't take shit from anyone.
en: No way. Titania is wicked cool. She doesn't take shit from anyone.
ja: いや、絶対ティタニアでしょ。超クールだし。誰にもなめられないんだから。

key: How can you guys say Florinia isn't the kindest? She's the one who stayed behind to take over this school and teach us!
en: How can you guys say Florinia isn't the kindest?  She's the one who stayed behind to take over this school and teach us!
ja: みんな、どうしてフロリニアが一番優しいって言わないの? この学校に残って、後を継いでわたしたちに教えてくれてるのに!

key: The best has gotta be Amy. She's so nice, and yet really strong, and cute, and... I'm so jealous!
en: The best has gotta be Amy. She's so nice, and yet really strong, and cute, and... I'm so jealous!
ja: 一番はエイミーに決まってる。優しいし、めちゃくちゃ強いし、可愛いし……もう羨ましすぎる!

key: Check out the Onyx School's fighting spirit!
en: Check out the Onyx School's fighting spirit!
ja: オニキス学校のファイティングスピリット、見てよ!

key: You've got your own spirit, huh.
en: You've got your own spirit, huh.
ja: 君にも、君なりの気概があるみたいだね。

key: You could fit in around here.
en: You could fit in around here.
ja: ここになじめそうじゃないか。

key: MAN: *HUFF PUFF* I... finally... caught you...
en: MAN: *HUFF PUFF* I... finally... caught you...
ja: 男: 〈ハァハァ〉やっと……追いついた……

key: LILLIPUP: Rrrr...uff!
en: LILLIPUP: Rrrr...uff!
ja: ヨーテリー: ウゥ……ワン!

key: MAN: Lillipup... I... can't keep... *HUFF* doing this...
en: MAN: Lillipup... I... can't keep... *HUFF* doing this...
ja: 男: ヨーテリー……もう……〈ハァ〉これ以上は無理だ……

key: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff!
en: LILLIPUP: Ruff! Ruff!
ja: ヨーテリー: ワン! ワン!

key: MAN: I'm... sorry, but... this is too much...
en: MAN: I'm... sorry, but... this is too much...
ja: 男: すまない……でも……もう限界なんだ……

key: I just can't keep up with you in my life.
en: I just can't keep up with you in my life.
ja: 俺の生活じゃ、お前についていけないんだよ。

key: Hm, I feel like I've seen you somewhere before...
en: Hm, I feel like I've seen you somewhere before...
ja: ん、どこかで会ったことあるような気がするな……

key: I'm sorry if I don't remember meeting you... Lillipup takes so much out of me, I can barely keep up.
en: I'm sorry if I don't remember meeting you... Lillipup takes so much out of me, I can barely keep up.
ja: 会ったことを覚えてなかったらすまない……ヨーテリーの世話でもう手一杯なんだ。

key: I hate to say it, but... I don't have the energy to give Lillipup the attention and care it needs.
en: I hate to say it, but... I don't have the energy to give Lillipup the attention and care it needs.
ja: 言いたくないけど……ヨーテリーに必要な世話をしてやる元気が、俺には残ってないんだ。

key: You seem like a pretty strong young Trainer.
en: You seem like a pretty strong young Trainer.
ja: 君は、なかなか強そうな若いトレーナーだな。

key: Would you be willing to look after my Lillipup?
en: Would you be willing to look after my Lillipup?
ja: 俺のヨーテリーの面倒を見てもらえないか?

key: Really? That's... I feel bad, but, it's a big relief.
en: Really? That's... I feel bad, but, it's a big relief.
ja: 本当か? それは……申し訳ないけど、正直すごく助かるよ。

key: Go ahead.
en: Go ahead.
ja: 頼むよ。

key: Now I'm just gonna rest right here...
en: Now I'm just gonna rest right here...
ja: さて、俺はここでちょっと休ませてもらうよ……

key: Ah, no, no worries... I understand, it's... It's a lot to handle.
en: Ah, no, no worries... I understand, it's... It's a lot to handle.
ja: ああ、いや、気にしないでくれ……わかるよ……大変だもんな。

key: Now I'm just gonna... rest right here for a while...
en: Now I'm just gonna... rest right here for a while...
ja: さて、俺は……ここでしばらく休ませてもらうよ……

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: You're in game-star territory now!
en: You're in game-star territory now!
ja: ここはゲームスターの縄張りだぞ!

key: Hey, no fair!
en: Hey, no fair!
ja: ちょっと、ズルい!

key: Whatever. When it comes to the game, I still rule.
en: Whatever. When it comes to the game, I still rule.
ja: まあいいや。ゲームに関しちゃ、まだアタシが女王だし。

key: "Onyx Trainers' School, formerly the Pokémon Technical Institute- Reborn's #1 Ivy League School"
en: "Onyx Trainers' School, formerly the Pokémon Technical Institute- Reborn's #1 Ivy League School"
ja: 「オニキストレーナー学校、旧・ポケモン工科大学――リボーン最高峰の名門校」

key: Well, then I was like--
en: Well, then I was like--
ja: で、それで、わたしはこう言ったの――

key: Hey, buddy, I'm busy here, back off. Besides, you don't look like a student.
en: Hey, buddy, I'm busy here, back off. Besides, you don't look like a student.
ja: おい、相棒、こっちは忙しいんだ、下がってろ。だいたい、お前、生徒には見えないしな。

key: If you're here for the Gym, use the Gym entrance on the other side. Duh.
en: If you're here for the Gym, use the Gym entrance on the other side. Duh.
ja: ジム目当てなら、反対側のジム入り口を使いなよ。当たり前でしょ。

key: Anyway, as I was saying...
en: Anyway, as I was saying...
ja: とにかく、さっきの話だけど……

key: Hey, you're the one they said to keep out, huh?
en: Hey, you're the one they said to keep out, huh?
ja: おい、お前、出入り禁止って言われてたやつだろ?

key: So much for that.
en: So much for that.
ja: そんなの、もう知ったことか。

key: Whatever. I never saw you.
en: Whatever. I never saw you.
ja: まあいいや。俺は何も見なかった。

key: No way! And then what?
en: No way! And then what?
ja: うそ! それでどうなったの?

key: >- Easterling Street\n^ - 10th Street
en: >- Easterling Street\n^ - 10th Street
ja: >-イースタリング通り\n^-10番通り

key: >- Ivyline Road\nv - 10th Street
en: >- Ivyline Road\nv - 10th Street
ja: >-アイビーライン通り\nv-10番通り

key: <- Ivyline Road\nv - 11th Street
en: <- Ivyline Road\nv - 11th Street
ja: <-アイビーライン通り\nv-11番通り

key: <- Easterling Street\n^v - 11th Street
en: <- Easterling Street\n^v - 11th Street
ja: <-イースタリング通り\n^v-11番通り

key: Oh, dear, oh, dear...
en: Oh, dear, oh, dear...
ja: あらあら、大変……

key: I lost the key to my home.
en: I lost the key to my home.
ja: 家の鍵をなくしちゃったの。

key: I must've dropped it somewhere, but where?
en: I must've dropped it somewhere, but where?
ja: どこかで落としたはずなんだけど、どこかしら?

key: Huh? Omigod, that's it! You found it!
en: Huh? Omigod, that's it! You found it!
ja: え? うそ、それよ! 見つけてくれたのね!

key: This is great! Now I don't have to stand here looking stupid in the rain all day!
en: This is great! Now I don't have to stand here looking stupid in the rain all day!
ja: よかった! これで一日中雨の中バカみたいに突っ立ってなくて済むわ!

key: Thank you so much!
en: Thank you so much!
ja: 本当にありがとう!

key: Hey, you might already know this, but I'm the Move Relearner!
en: Hey, you might already know this, but I'm the Move Relearner!
ja: ねえ、もう知ってるかもしれないけど、わたしはわざおもいだし屋なの!

key: So I can pay you back for helping me! Normally I charge a Heart Scale, but since you found this for me...
en: So I can pay you back for helping me! Normally I charge a Heart Scale, but since you found this for me...
ja: だから、助けてくれたお礼ができるわ! いつもはハートのウロコをもらうんだけど、これを見つけてくれたお礼だから……

key: Ah, well, here, how about this?
en: Ah, well, here, how about this?
ja: そうね、じゃあ、これはどう?

key: Okay, I'm going inside now. Come around whenever you need!
en: Okay, I'm going inside now. Come around whenever you need!
ja: さ、わたしはもう中に入るわね。必要な時はいつでも寄ってね!

key: I'll keep looking... I have to find it.
en: I'll keep looking... I have to find it.
ja: 探し続けなきゃ……見つけないと。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
